title: A page Kumo made
summary: You ask what not to miss at a museum. Kumo makes a page, a guide in walking order with things to spot, and answers in a few sentences with a card that opens it. You open it. The next morning Kumo keeps it current: a room reopened, so it's back in, with a note that says so. At the museum you tick things off as you spot them, and the Made shelf lists the page.

body.text: We're at the V&A tomorrow for two hours. What shouldn't I miss?
